items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Just incidentally, Norman was very kind. I’d asked for a weekly stipend as an advance on the royalties and that helped a lot

ctx.x: Yeah. The Image record was you first one and the Motion record was your last one for Verve.

Just incidentally, Norman was very kind. I’d asked for a weekly stipend as an advance on the royalties and that helped a lot, a hundred dollars a week or whatever he gave me. I always appreciated that.
He treated you well even if he wasn’t a big fan of your music.
